name: TAM Tech Nights
title: Tech nights at the Temple of Art and Music
lede: Meetups, demo nights and build nights for AI companies, crypto chains and the communities around them, in a live music venue in Elephant & Castle, London. Talks first, then the stage is handed to the band.

formats.title: Meetups and talks
formats.text: Your community, your speakers, a stage, a PA and a screen. Then drinks, and live music to finish.

formats.title: Demo nights
formats.text: Founders and builders show what they’ve made, to a room that isn’t only developers.

formats.title: Build nights and hackathons
formats.text: Bring the laptops. Build through the evening, demo at the end, celebrate on the dance floor.

formats.title: AI and music
formats.text: Where tech meets TAM’s artists: AI songwriting, new tools for musicians and live performance. TAM has done it before, with AI by Casperaki at its 16th anniversary.

offer.title: A venue with a stage
offer.text: A live music room in Elephant & Castle, London, with a stage, sound and a bar.

offer.title: Tickets and RSVPs
offer.text: Free or paid tickets through TAM’s own box office, with QR codes at the door and a guest list you can download.

offer.title: A page that lasts
offer.text: Every night gets its own page on TAM.TV, written for search engines and AI assistants, so people can still find it afterwards.

offer.title: Live music and TAM TV
offer.text: Close the night with TAM’s artists. Ask about filming the talks or the night for TAM TV.

communities.name: Bitcoin
communities.text: The first cryptocurrency, running since 2009.

communities.name: Ethereum

communities.name: Solana
communities.text: A high-throughput blockchain with a big developer and consumer-app scene.

communities.name: XRP Ledger

communities.name: Cardano
communities.text: A research-driven proof-of-stake blockchain with a strong grassroots community.

communities.name: Avalanche
communities.text: A fast blockchain platform where projects can launch their own chains.

communities.name: TON
communities.text: The Open Network, the blockchain built into Telegram’s mini apps and wallet.

communities.name: Polkadot
communities.text: A network that connects many specialised blockchains.

communities.name: Chainlink
communities.text: Connects blockchains to real-world data and to each other.

communities.name: Polygon
communities.text: A network for fast, cheap payments and apps, connected to Ethereum.

communities.name: NEAR
communities.text: A blockchain focused on usability and on AI.

communities.name: Sui
communities.text: A newer blockchain built on the Move language, launched in 2023.

communities.name: Aptos
communities.text: A blockchain built on the Move language, launched in 2022.

communities.name: Arbitrum

communities.name: Optimism

communities.name: Base

communities.name: Cosmos

communities.name: Hedera

communities.name: Algorand
